patch_description: Structural redesign around a two-phase global pipeline: (1) vectorized water-filling replication + heap-based LPT packing (as in the best prior variant), followed by (2) a new swap-based local-search refinement pass that moves/ swaps physical experts between the most-loaded and least-loaded GPUs per layer until no imbalance-reducing swap remains. This directly targets the GPU and expert balancedness scores (0.76/0.29) while keeping all heavy operations in vectorized numpy/torch so runtime stays low. The refinement operates jointly on (logical-id, replica-rank) pairs so the final maps stay consistent.
